versions.content: Service Name Can_ Set Baudrate Syntax Std_ Return Type Can_ Set Baudrate ( uint8 Controller, uint16 Baud Rate Config ID ) Service ID [hex] 0x0f Sync/ Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant for different Controllers. Non reentrant for the same Controller. Parameters (in) Controller CAN controller, whose baud rate shall be set Baud Rate Config ID references a baud rate configuration by ID (see Can Controller Baud Rate Config ID) Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std _ Return Type E_ OK: Service request accepted, setting of (new) baud rate started E_ NOT_ OK: Service request not accepted Description This service shall set the baud rate configuration of the CAN controller. Depending on necessary baud rate modifications the controller might have to reset. Available via Can.h
